open_questions: Call-site mismatches with merged symbols: Scr_Init and Scr_IsInitialized are called with an int argument, AnglesToAxis_ZUp is called with a float yaw, AnglesToForward_ProjectedNormalized and QuatTransform_ToMat3 receive non-pointer arguments; these callees use fn_ placeholders (fn_080844de, fn_08084678, fn_080a94f2, fn_080aaa30, fn_080ab4a0). Merge lane should reconcile signatures.

Turret_PositionUser (0x0810aa50) is partial: the fn_080c0* / fn_080c2930 / fn_080c15ba anim-tree helper contracts (argument meanings) and the g_087035bc bank layout beyond +0x4a4 are unresolved; float/long double precision follows the disassembly.

Turret_ComputeFlashFrame (0x0810a880): fn_0811e542 writes a tag orientation; the origin is read at float index 9 of a 48-byte buffer (inferred from the stack layout); confirm the callee's output size.
Turret_StartReload call site (0x0810a982 via 0x0810b7e0) passes a third zero argument that the two-parameter callee ignores; confirm whether the true callee takes a third argument.

Turret seat index comes from input flags bits 20..24 and indexes 4-element weaponinfo arrays unk3a0/unk3fc (0x3a0, 0x3fc); seats above 3 read past the array (faithful to the binary but undefined in C).
G_InitGame zeroes 0x3624 bytes starting at the global g_0864c380 (memset of the global block); this is layout dependent and must be preserved by the merge lane's global placement.
G_TeleportEntity (0x0810a708): the z lift of 1.0 is inferred from the Quake III TeleportPlayer pattern (naming reference only); the observed code adds 1.0 to client origin[2].
Turret_UpdateAimState (0x0810a982) and the trace wrappers 0x0810a5cc/0x0810a622/0x0810a672 are named unknown; their roles are fixed only by argument forwarding.
Float_Select and Float_Clamp were checked against disassembly (0x0810ceea, 0x0810ccf2); the decompiler return types were lost (float via st0).
trace_s byte 0x23 (flagAt23) and gentity +0x050 bit 0x4 test semantics are unknown.
Several gentity/client fields are named fieldNNN where no consistent role was recovered; the merge lane should cross-check them against chunks that touch the same offsets.
